text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was hardly a walk in the park,
though I
suppose I shouldn't be
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, I demonstrated my strength
convincingly
enough. I can face the
senior races with my head
held high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, answer me this. The three crowns I
long
sought are already mine—what
prize do you
suppose I should seek to
claim next?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Now that I'm a senior,
ambitious
classic-year racers and my
capable
contemporaries alike will all
seek to oust me from
my throne.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall need a grand and storied shield
with which
to defend my honor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My thoughts exactly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
3,200 meters is a grueling distance, but
it
presents the perfect opportunity to
demonstrate
my prowess as a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And victory in the Tenno Sho grants a
particular
prestige.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us honor the suffering and
perseverance of
our forebears with a
stunning victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so we set our sights on the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to the waiting room to find...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You raced well today, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove. Have you been waiting
for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Only to pass on my congratulations. Now
that
that's done, I ought to head back
home.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is it my imagination, or do you look a
little under
the weather?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your complexion strikes me as somewhat
pale. As
though you've been missing
sleep... or perhaps
meals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Apologies. My student council duties
have been
taking up a lot of my time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's not like you to let them get out of
hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This year's New Year's party has required
more
paperwork than usual, and
attending to it has
been somewhat
time-consuming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I can gather, it sounds like
Air Groove
has been in charge of
organizing the New Year's
party that the
student council runs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you say something? Let me
take
charge of this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. For all the
virtue of
hard work, you have been
pushing yourself too
much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You may be exceptional, but even you
have your
limits, especially in this busy
season. Surely you
can lean on me once
in a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, I ought to attend to student
council
business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fortuitously enough, my last great task
of the
year has just concluded. Excellent
timing, if I do
say so myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have a request for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take care of Air Groove. See that she
gets some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And could you pick out something for us
to eat
while I finish things up here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no need for that. I can do it
myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between your fatigue-addled mind and
my
trainer's ample experience, which
would you say is
the more suitable
candidate?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Point taken.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then my request stands. Trainer, if you
would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a light snack, Symboli Rudolf and
Air
Groove head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's party ends up a great
success and
is very much appreciated by
the Umamusume
staying at school over
the holidays.
